Two tabs, packages instead of loose links, and a tablet gets its second column.

## ✨ Added

- **A Downloads tab and a Collector tab.** They are one task list with one status telling them apart — "collected" means staged and not started — so this is a filter over what already streams rather than a second request. The strip only appears once something is actually staged: a tab that is always empty teaches you to ignore the strip.
- **A play badge on every package in the collector.** It moves that package into the queue and switches to the Downloads tab, so the thing you just started is the thing you are looking at.
- **Two columns on a tablet.** The first tablet pass capped the content width and centred it, which stops a card being 900 points wide but leaves half the screen empty; on a real tablet that half is now a second column of instance cards, and the queue bar sits beside the speed graph instead of above it. 900 dp is the threshold — every phone in portrait is far below it, and a phone in landscape is deliberately excluded, being short enough that a second column costs more height than it buys width.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The task list is grouped into packages, not one row per link.** A container is one thing somebody added, usually a dozen files or a hundred, and a flat list of them says nothing about what was added — the same reason the web interface and JDownloader both group this way. Each package header carries its file count and size.
